say:1:1560102001:1.text: Welcome to the first-ever Ryeham Pumpkin Pummel! I'm Lana, your prize manager.
say:1:1560102001:1.source_cn: 欢迎来到金穗村首届南瓜杯擂台赛！我是大赛的奖品管理员拉娜！
say:1:1560102001:1.male: Welcome to the first-ever Ryeham Pumpkin Pummel! I'm Lana, your prize manager.
say:1:1560102001:1.female: Welcome to the first-ever Ryeham Pumpkin Pummel! I'm Lana, your prize manager.

say:2:1560102002:1.text: Chief Truman has organized this event to celebrate the Fall Harvest.
say:2:1560102002:1.source_cn: 正值秋夜节之际，村长特鲁曼特地举办了这场南瓜杯擂台赛。
say:2:1560102002:1.male: Chief Truman has organized this event to celebrate the Fall Harvest.
say:2:1560102002:1.female: Chief Truman has organized this event to celebrate the Fall Harvest.

say:3:1560102003:1.text: This event isn't just a test of strength! It's also a chance to light up the autumn night with pumpkin lanterns and celebrate the bountiful harvest!
say:3:1560102003:1.source_cn: 这场擂台赛不仅是为了展示大家的体魄，更是要在这个神秘的...
say:3:1560102003:1.male: This event isn't just a test of strength! It's also a chance to light up the autumn night with pumpkin lanterns and celebrate the bountiful harvest!
say:3:1560102003:1.female: This event isn't just a test of strength! It's also a chance to light up the autumn night with pumpkin lanterns and celebrate the bountiful harvest!

say:4:1560102004:1.text: Take part in this event to get Gourd Tokens and the rare Gourd Medallions!
say:4:1560102004:1.source_cn: 参加比赛就能获得南瓜币和稀有的金秋南瓜币！
say:4:1560102004:1.male: Take part in this event to get Gourd Tokens and the rare Gourd Medallions!
say:4:1560102004:1.female: Take part in this event to get Gourd Tokens and the rare Gourd Medallions!

say:5:1560102005:1.text: Redeem your prizes at <style="highlight">my kiosk</style> now!
say:5:1560102005:1.male: Redeem your prizes at <style="highlight">my kiosk</style> now!
say:5:1560102005:1.female: Redeem your prizes at <style="highlight">my kiosk</style> now!

say:6:1560102006:1.text: Exclusive autumn-themed accessories await! Grab them now, or wait until next year!
say:6:1560102006:1.source_cn: 更有限定的秋夜饰品等你来哦，错过就要等明年了！！
say:6:1560102006:1.male: Exclusive autumn-themed accessories await! Grab them now, or wait until next year!
say:6:1560102006:1.female: Exclusive autumn-themed accessories await! Grab them now, or wait until next year!
